messages.subject: Detector/Trap ID numbers
parts:
Has anybody had issues with SECR failing to match capture locations to detector sites? It seems to be ok with only numbers, but not with letters followed by numbers.
E.G. it's ok with 01..., but not ok with BG01... 
This is for differentiating between grids.

messages.subject: Re: Detector/Trap ID numbers
parts:
It's always worked for me... Check for Excel problems - hidden blanks etc. B1 is not the same as B01.
